headline: Bitcoin And MSTR Are Reeling, But Polymarket Continues To Onboard Users To Crypto
summary: A new Bitget Wallet study found nearly 60% of Polymarket's 857,377 active users had never traded on a DEX before, suggesting the platform has become crypto's biggest mainstream onboarding gateway.
